verificationNotes: Final 33 purchase integration checks use real PG/Redis and call the internal transactional process boundary, not RabbitMQ.
Tests verify rollback after outbox, ledger and final request transition faults; no failed delivery is marked accepted.
Actual FK lock wait across authentication expiry rolls back acceptance. Actual ticket lock wait across request deadline yields EXPIRED without holding stock.
Initial compilation overload corrected and old catalog migration count updated to five. Final full package passed all 146 checks.
HTTP smoke customer handle shortened to respect the existing 40-character account limit before retained-V4 order seeding.
Production HTTP profile uses a ten-second acceptance deadline and one-second expiry sweep; default remains sixty seconds/thirty-second sweep.

Before V5 was committed/published, terminal closed_at non-null checks were strengthened. Recreated only own empty PG scope, reseeded retained V4, reran full 146 tests and all recorded HTTP/browser/upgrade/restart/outage checks against final JAR; no Flyway repair/clean.
A cold purchase-test Redis client yielded fail-closed 503 once. Added bounded real client PONG readiness before assertions; unchanged 500ms production timeout and admission assertions.
Fresh container startup initially preceded PG readiness; restarted own baseline API after actual healthy containers and awaited public API200 before successful final V4 seeding.
